reviews.topicGoldEvaluation: Not performed; six topic probabilities per row inspected qualitatively, no independent topic gold set.

limits: Hand-authored challenge cases, not a representative production accuracy or calibration benchmark.
Only routing has a predeclared 8-case holdout; no wording tuning followed the observed holdout.
The rules baseline is routeLiveQuery, not the complete pipeline with its fallback generative classifier.
The initial Score request used an object for criteria, returned HTTP 400, and was corrected to the documented array form. It is retained as an error, not counted as a judgment.
Timing is local end-to-end HTTP time; the 3 serial samples are insufficient for a production p95 or SLA.
No live comparison against the user's ordinary chat model; no claimed total application speedup or realized cost savings.
The HTTP 400 response has no usage receipt; cost total sums successful receipts only.
